analysis: The only change in this PR is one documentation row in docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head line 1745, outside the supplied excerpts), which adds DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SHAPE_WARMUP to the environment-variable table. The row says `0` disables the load-time shape warmup and `always` skips its shader-cache probe. No executable code, protocol, authorization, attestation, encryption, key handling or trust-boundary behavior changes in the supplied evidence. I read the supplied head-text units (lines 1-824) and found no material security drift. The prefix-cache text (cache set, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 opt-out, encrypted SSD defaults) matches T-041's posture. The logout, revocation and App Attest descriptions are consistent with the TB-011 and A-008 notes in the canonical context. The new variable is a performance knob, with no stated effect on A-001, the key assets or the attestation chain. I did not see the implementation in ModelCalibrationPolicy.swift. Whether the `always` mode's shader-cache probe skip or the warmup path handles prompt or user data is therefore unverified. Warmup presumably uses synthetic inputs, so I recorded no finding. A later pass should check that the warmup uses only synthetic data and writes no plaintext artifacts, per T-028 and T-050, if that source is in scope.
